# /hunt:close

ARGUMENTS = what the user wrote with this request (<listing id or name of the chosen place>); empty if nothing. Skills named below are this plugin's skills (`hunt:<name>` in Codex), tools are the tools of its MCP servers (hunt, hunt-telegram, hunt-browser, hunt-bridge).

Use skill `hunt-deal` → "Close the search" and skill `hunt-outreach` → close-out. Chosen place: ARGUMENTS (do not message its contacts). First show the list of who will get what (by channel) and wait for the user's yes, then send and report per channel.
